title: Cross-Signal Lag Correlation
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=correlation:pair
| search lag_hours=*
| stats avg(lag_hours) as avg_lag_hours avg(correlation_score) as avg_correlation_score by left_signal right_signal
| sort 0 - avg_lag_hours
description: Ranks signal pairss by cross-signal lag correlation.
value: Lag correlation matters because cause-and-effect patterns often arrive hours later rather than at the same timestamp.
implementation: Send cross-signal lag correlation events to `index=personal` and keep `left_signal` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of cross-signal lag correlation by signal pairs.
grandmaExplanation: It turns which signal pairss stand out most for cross-signal lag correlation.
